name: WF-423 — Title Clearance → Closing Date & Final Settlement Coordination Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const assignmentId=String(b.assignmentId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,assignmentId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Final Settlement Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const title=ctx.title??{}; const closing=ctx.closing??{}; const settlement=ctx.settlement??{}; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const flags=[]; const titleClear=title.clearToClose===true||title.status==='clear'; const contractExecuted=ctx.contractExecutionStatus==='executed'||d.assignmentContractExecuted===true; const fundsReady=settlement.fundsReady===true; const buyerReady=ctx.buyerReady===true||ctx.buyer?.closingReady===true; const sellerReady=ctx.sellerReady===true||ctx.seller?.closingReady===true; if(!contractExecuted)flags.push('assignment_contract_not_executed'); if(!titleClear)flags.push('title_not_clear'); if(!fundsReady)flags.push('funds_not_ready'); if(!buyerReady)flags.push('buyer_closing_readiness_missing'); if(!sellerReady)flags.push('seller_closing_readiness_missing'); if(closing.status&&['failed','cancelled'].includes(String(closing.status).toLowerCase()))flags.push('closing_process_blocked'); const hardBlock=flags.includes('assignment_contract_not_executed')||flags.includes('title_not_clear')||flags.includes('closing_process_blocked'); const ready=flags.length===0; const status=hardBlock?'blocked':ready?'ready_for_scheduling':'pending_requirements'; const proposedDate=ctx.proposedClosingDate??closing.proposedDate??null; const confirmedDate=ctx.confirmedClosingDate??closing.confirmedDate??null; const settlementPackage={assignmentId:input.assignmentId,dealId:input.dealId,propertyId:input.propertyId,closingDate:confirmedDate??proposedDate,titleStatus:title.status??null,contractExecuted,fundsReady,buyerReady,sellerReady,settlementStatementId:settlement.statementId??null,expectedAssignmentFee:settlement.assignmentFee??d.assignmentFee??null,expectedBuyerFunds:settlement.buyerFunds??null,expectedSellerPayoff:settlement.sellerPayoff??null}; const nextAction=status==='ready_for_scheduling'?'confirm_closing_date_and_finalize_settlement':status==='blocked'?'resolve_title_contract_or_closing_blocker':'collect_remaining_closing_requirements'; const idempotencyKey='wf423:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.assignmentId; return [{json:{...input,finalSettlementCoordination:{status,nextAction,flags,settlementPackage,requiredActions:status==='ready_for_scheduling'?['confirm_closing_date','finalize_settlement_statement','confirm_buyer_funds','confirm_seller_payoff','confirm_assignment_fee','release_final_closing_package']:['resolve_blockers','refresh_title_and_closing_readiness','recalculate_settlement'],confidenceScore:ready?95:Math.max(0,65-flags.length*8)},idempotencyKey}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ {status:'blocked',reason:'leadId, propertyId, dealId and assignmentId are required'} }}

meta.notes: Final settlement coordination is workflow scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM settlement schema, title/closing provider integrations, final settlement statement data, and production API contracts.
